part.name: OD-G11_portafilter
part.what_it_is: Espresso portafilter scanned as one assembly: cast cup with three bayonet lugs, two spout bosses with pan-head screws and a centre screw, open-bottom arch neck, tapered grip with collar and end cap, a pressurised insert (funnel floor, outlet trough, U rib, two V ribs, outlet pockets) and a round-wire retaining spring. Delivered as ONE fused solid (owner decision).

method_summary: Datum: cup rim end face (gasket seat) is z = 0 with +Z out of the opening; cup axis from wall-face circle fits; handle end-cap normal clocks the handle to +X.
Scan-only parameters: every value is a primitive fit on the aligned scan (lines, circles, spheres, cones, planes) kept as measured; see the source column. No calipers.

build123d: revolved cup profile minus a revolved cavity cut by a funnel cone and an outlet trough; lugs with two ramp planes, pad, arch neck, neck/collar/grip revolves, spouts, drafted ribs, screws, wire arcs; one valid solid exported in the datum and scan frames.
Two independent verifications on the full-resolution scan under regime {{gate:regime.name}}; iteration 1 REVISE, iteration 2 {{gate:verdict}}, band miss accepted by the owner.

limitations.text: Tier-1 not run (tier1 partial: none of the requested dims has a caliper reading, owner chose scan-only); absolute scale is not caliper-verified (CHK-SCALE flag). All requested dims are absent, not passed.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any caliper reading (rim bore ID, ledge depth, lug under-face heights, spout spacing): fill input/MEASUREMENTS.md, rehash, re-run verify

limitations.text: Unscanned or occluded regions carry invented or interpolated CAD and set the observable CAD->scan miss (max {{gate:deviation.cad_to_scan_observable.max}} mm): the two outlet-pocket bores (depth assumed), the insert floor inside the U rib (open scan region) and a strip along the grip that the scanner missed.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a rescan covering the pocket interiors, the insert floor inside the U rib and the grip strip, or a depth-gauge reading of the pocket depth

limitations.text: The fine tessellation of both STEPs has two zero-area triangles each (spout-1 root / bottom-round junction and the insert floor near the trough); the B-rep itself is one valid closed solid with no naked edges.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any rebuild: re-run step_check and the tessellation probe

limitations.text: Verify ICP needed its iteration cap raised once (same as iteration 1); both runs and the no-ICP datum-frame run agree, so the gate numbers do not depend on it.
limitations.rerun_trigger: any rebuild: re-run ICP at the default cap first

limitations.text: One fused solid of an assembly: internal interfaces between cup, insert, grip, cap, screws and wire are not represented; the wire is three planar arcs and the screw heads are simplified. The wire arc sets the scan->CAD max {{gate:deviation.scan_to_cad.max}} mm.
limitations.rerun_trigger: an owner decision to model the wire as a swept path, orient the screw recesses, or model the bodies separately

limitations.text: The verify deviation gate ran through a memory-only wrapper (smaller observability ray chunk) because the unmodified script was killed for lack of memory; the per-point result is identical.
limitations.rerun_trigger: observability chunk size exposed on the deviation_gate.py CLI: re-run it directly

limitations.text: Protocol carried unchanged from iteration 1: masks apply to CAD->scan only, so scan points on scan-hole edges stay in the gated scan->CAD statistic, and the observable CAD->scan subset is unmasked.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a protocol decision declared before the next gate (for example a scan-side open-boundary mask), then re-run verify reporting both

limitations.text: CHK-FILLET: the leg-foot rounds on the flared neck-cone part were built REDUCED ({{params:arch_foot_round_R.value}} mm target, a smaller declared fallback used; see export_check.json fillets); all other fillets are at their target radius.
limitations.rerun_trigger: a rebuild of the neck that splits the cone-part foot edges so the full radius applies

assumptions.text: Spout pocket bore radius and depth below the insert floor are invented (the scan has open holes there).
Screw cross-recess width and orientation, spout screw head rim radius, collar crest and end-face rounds were read by eye from section figures.
Material between the outer and inner scanned surfaces is filled solid (one fused solid of cast cup, plastic insert, grip, cap, screws and wire).
Units assumed millimetres; no scale applied (no calipers).

not_fit_for: manufacture, tooling or fit-critical use: the band was NOT met (max and observable CAD->scan) and no dimension is caliper-verified
modelling the separate bodies (cup, insert, grip, screws, wire): this is one fused solid
the pocket interiors and the grip strip, which are invented or interpolated
fit_for: visualisation, packaging and fixture design around the portafilter envelope
a design-intent starting point (cup, rim, lugs, bore, handle agree with the scan within the p95 band)
re-measurement with calipers against the named parameters

feature_tree.feature: cup outer revolve (dome, drafted wall, rim)
cavity: bore, ledge, taper, insert wall, funnel floor, outlet trough
spout bosses with screw heads, pockets
U plateau, U rib, V ribs
three bayonet lugs with ramp and lead-out, rim notches
pad, arch neck with rounded feet, neck cone, collar, grip, end cap
screw recesses, wire groove, wire arcs
